slides.title: COUNT = [[ginti]] master
points: Rows **ginta** hai, ek number deta hai

slides.title: Delhi mein [[kitne]]?
slides.code:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM employees
WHERE city = 'Delhi';
-- Result: 3
slides.note: Aarav, Kabir, Dev = **3**. Result sirf **ek number** ☝️

slides.title: Ab [[bonus]] column dekho
slides.note: Meera aur Riya ka bonus **NULL**. Ab twist aayega 👀

slides.title: Teen COUNT, [[teen]] jawab
slides.note: COUNT(col) **NULL skip** karta hai, COUNT(*) sab ginta hai

slides.title: Alias [[laga do]]
slides.note: Khaali table pe COUNT = **0**, NULL nahi. SUM/AVG se alag 😉

slides.why: Bonus NULL wale skip → 5 ki jagah **3**. Report galat 📉
